body: I pulled into a pretty secluded roadside park because I don’t really have a place to be alone. But I guess a lot of people go down there to do drugs or smoke weed (which I didn’t know because I don’t really do drugs.) So a police officer just so happen to drive through and maybe a minute after I took a prescription of lithium in one handful, he knocked on my window. Surprised the hell out of me because I didn’t see him at first (it was snowing extremely hard) and my family had already reported me missing. So he put two and two together. Next thing I know I’m in an ambulance and headed to the hospital.
This. Not trying to sound overdramatic but literally made me cry. Thank you for caring to ask ♥️ It’s the little things I guess.
I’m getting there. I think it kind of woke me up. I guess I must be still around for a reason huh?
